summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (TGS) solely to announce the filing of its 2025 annual report on Form 20-F with the SEC. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, restructuring, or other special-situation event. There are no deal terms, advisor mentions, or break-fee provisions. As a standard annual reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer, this document is not a special-situations event.
